name: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc
source: NGX filing library (doclib.ngxgroup.com). FY2024 audited by Baker Tilly Nigeria: Statement of Profit or Loss for the year ended 30 April 2024. FY2025 unaudited year end statement for the year ended 30 April 2025. Naira thousands as filed, stored in NGN. Income Tax is the net tax line (current tax 22,935 less deferred tax credit 70,940 in FY2024).

rows.label: Revenue
rows.source: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc audited statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 April 2023, N'000, printed page 13 (file _ngx_pdf/MULTITREX.pdf page index 14), columns 2023 and 2022. Every filled figure is checked against the statement: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, gross profit plus other operating income less administrative expenses equals the operating loss, and the operating loss less interest expenses equals the loss before taxation.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2023: the statement strikes operating profit after further income and expense lines (Other Operating Income) that the two-row identity does not carry. Both figures are as filed and are shown unchanged.
source_note: FY2024 audited figures read from the Statement of Profit or Loss, page 19. FY2025 figures read from the unaudited year end statement (TURNOVER 47,900; COST OF SALES (6,576); GROSS PROFIT 41,324; OTHER INCOME 283,995; OPERATING EXPENSES (582,384); FINANCE CHARGES (213,981); PBT (471,046)). Identities tie: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; PBT less net tax equals PAT.
